response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, cnt AS employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10;
